dz: 拿破仑战争：法国海军击败英国皇家海军，阻止他们占领法兰西岛大港的港口。
de: Napoleonic Wars: The French Navy defeats the British Royal Navy, preventing them from taking the harbour of Grand Port on Île de France.

t: 沃尔夫·通(英语:Wolfe Tone)的爱尔兰和法国联合军在1798年爱尔兰起义的一部分卡塞…
te: Wolfe Tone's United Irish and French forces clash with the British Army in the Battle of Castlebar, part of the Irish R…
dz: 沃尔夫·通(英语:Wolfe Tone)的爱尔兰和法国联合军在1798年爱尔兰起义的一部分卡塞尔巴尔战役中与英国军队相冲突,导致法国傀儡康纳克特共和国的建立.
de: Wolfe Tone's United Irish and French forces clash with the British Army in the Battle of Castlebar, part of the Irish Rebellion of 1798, resulting in the creation of the French puppet Republic of Connacht.

t: 土伦市反抗法兰西共和国，并允许英国和西班牙舰队占领其港口，导致法国革命军队围攻土伦。
te: The city of Toulon revolts against the French Republic and admits the British and Spanish fleets to seize its port, lea…
dz: 法国革命战争：土伦市反抗法兰西共和国，并允许英国和西班牙舰队占领其港口，导致法国革命军队围攻土伦。
de: French Revolutionary Wars: The city of Toulon revolts against the French Republic and admits the British and Spanish fleets to seize its port, leading to the Siege of Toulon by French Revolutionary forces.

t: 普鲁士腓特烈·威廉二世与神圣罗马帝国皇帝利奥波德二世发表《皮尔尼茨宣言》，宣布神圣罗马帝国和普…
te: Frederick William II of Prussia and Leopold II, Holy Roman Emperor, issue the Declaration of Pillnitz, declaring the jo…
dz: 法国大革命：普鲁士腓特烈·威廉二世与神圣罗马帝国皇帝利奥波德二世发表《皮尔尼茨宣言》，宣布神圣罗马帝国和普鲁士共同支持法国君主制，煽动法国革命派，促成第一次反法同盟战争的爆发。
de: French Revolution: Frederick William II of Prussia and Leopold II, Holy Roman Emperor, issue the Declaration of Pillnitz, declaring the joint support of the Holy Roman Empire and Prussia for the French monarchy, agitating the French revolutionaries and contributing to the outbreak of the War of the First Coalition.

t: 在长岛战役中，威廉·豪将军领导的英国军队从侧翼攻击并击败了乔治·华盛顿将军领导的大陆军，马里兰…
te: British forces under General William Howe flank and defeat the Continental Army under General George Washington during …
dz: 美国独立战争：在长岛战役中，威廉·豪将军领导的英国军队从侧翼攻击并击败了乔治·华盛顿将军领导的大陆军，马里兰第一军团在掩护撤退的美军时伤亡惨重。
de: American Revolutionary War: British forces under General William Howe flank and defeat the Continental Army under General George Washington during the Battle of Long Island, with the 1st Maryland Regiment sustaining heavy casualties to cover retreating American troops.

t: "内尔琴斯克条约"由俄罗斯和清帝国签订(儒略历).
te: The Treaty of Nerchinsk is signed by Russia and the Qing Empire (Julian calendar).
dz: "内尔琴斯克条约"由俄罗斯和清帝国签订(儒略历).
de: The Treaty of Nerchinsk is signed by Russia and the Qing Empire (Julian calendar).

t: 石田三成的西军开始围攻伏见城，鸟居元忠率领的德川驻军规模小得多，但对伏见城的防守却很薄弱。

dz: 石田三成的西军开始围攻伏见城，鸟居元忠率领的德川驻军规模小得多，但对伏见城的防守却很薄弱。
de: Ishida Mitsunari's Western Army commences the Siege of Fushimi Castle, which is lightly defended by a much smaller Tokugawa garrison led by Torii Mototada.

t: Chilcheollyang 战役: 日本舰队的 500 艘船在 Chilcheollyang…
te: Battle of Chilcheollyang: A Japanese fleet of 500 ships destroys Joseon commander Wŏn Kyun's fleet of 200 ships at Chil…
dz: Jeongyu War: Chilcheollyang 战役: 日本舰队的 500 艘船在 Chilcheollyang 摧毁了朝鲜指挥官 Wŏn Kyun 的 200 艘船队。
de: Jeongyu War: Battle of Chilcheollyang: A Japanese fleet of 500 ships destroys Joseon commander Wŏn Kyun's fleet of 200 ships at Chilcheollyang.

t: 皮埃尔·巴里埃试图刺杀法国的亨利四世而失败.
te: Pierre Barrière fails in an attempt to assassinate Henry IV of France.
dz: 皮埃尔·巴里埃试图刺杀法国的亨利四世而失败.
de: Pierre Barrière fails in an attempt to assassinate Henry IV of France.

t: 圣康坦战役使埃马纽埃尔·菲利伯特出任萨伏依公爵.
te: The Battle of St. Quentin results in Emmanuel Philibert becoming Duke of Savoy.
dz: 圣康坦战役使埃马纽埃尔·菲利伯特出任萨伏依公爵.
de: The Battle of St. Quentin results in Emmanuel Philibert becoming Duke of Savoy.

t: 阿尔盖罗战役使盟军阿拉贡和威尼斯分舰队对热那亚分舰队取得了压倒性的胜利,大部分被俘.
te: War of the Straits and Sardinian–Aragonese war: The Battle of Alghero results in a crushing victory of the allied Arago…
dz: 海峡和撒丁岛之战-阿拉贡战争:阿尔盖罗战役使盟军阿拉贡和威尼斯分舰队对热那亚分舰队取得了压倒性的胜利,大部分被俘.
de: War of the Straits and Sardinian–Aragonese war: The Battle of Alghero results in a crushing victory of the allied Aragonese and Venetian fleet over the Genoese fleet, most of which is captured.

t: 镰仓幕府的北条康时颁布了《御成拜式目》，这是日本第一部管理武士阶级的法律法规。
te: Shikken Hojo Yasutoki of the Kamakura shogunate promulgates the Goseibai Shikimoku, the first Japanese legal code gover…
dz: 镰仓幕府的北条康时颁布了《御成拜式目》，这是日本第一部管理武士阶级的法律法规。
de: Shikken Hojo Yasutoki of the Kamakura shogunate promulgates the Goseibai Shikimoku, the first Japanese legal code governing the samurai class.

t: 法国的年轻国王亨利和玛格丽特被加冕为英国的初级国王和女王.
te: Henry the Young King and Margaret of France are crowned junior king and queen of England.
dz: 法国的年轻国王亨利和玛格丽特被加冕为英国的初级国王和女王.
de: Henry the Young King and Margaret of France are crowned junior king and queen of England.

t: 维西哥斯人对罗马的封杀在三天后结束.
te: The sacking of Rome by the Visigoths ends after three days.
dz: 维西哥斯人对罗马的封杀在三天后结束.
de: The sacking of Rome by the Visigoths ends after three days.
